ledger.sentence: An echocardiogram is a scan that uses ultrasound, high-frequency sound waves, to produce moving pictures of the heart.
ledger.note: NHS/MedlinePlus: ultrasound used to create pictures of the heart.

ledger.sentence: An ultrasound probe covered in gel is placed on the chest in the standard test.
ledger.note: Gel and transducer on chest supported; "water-based" not retrieved.

ledger.sentence: The most common type is the transthoracic echocardiogram, in which the probe is placed over the chest.
ledger.note: NHS: most common type is transthoracic, transducer placed on chest.

ledger.sentence: A transoesophageal echocardiogram uses a probe that passes down the throat and gives more detailed pictures of the heart than the standard test.
ledger.note: NHS: probe passed down the throat, more detailed view of the heart.

ledger.sentence: Doctors may use it when the standard test has not shown enough detail.
ledger.note: RBHT (NHS trust): generally used when a chest echo cannot give enough information.

ledger.sentence: A stress echocardiogram is a transthoracic scan done during exercise on a treadmill or exercise bike, or after a medicine that has a similar effect on the heart.
ledger.note: NHS: treadmill or exercise bike, or medicine with similar effect.

ledger.sentence: For some echocardiograms, saline or a special dye is injected into a vein to help show the heart more clearly.
ledger.note: Retrieved (likely NHLBI/MedlinePlus, US): saline or special dye injected into a vein for some echoes. "Harmless" and "clearer image" not retrieved.

ledger.sentence: A stress echocardiogram may be recommended if a heart problem is triggered by physical activity.
ledger.note: NHS: stress echo may be recommended when a heart problem is triggered by physical activity.

ledger.sentence: For the transoesophageal test, the back of the throat is numbed with an anaesthetic spray.
ledger.note: NHS: throat numbed with spray for TOE.

ledger.sentence: A sedative may be given to help the person relax.
ledger.note: NHS: a sedative given to help you relax; "very drowsy but not asleep" and "people can ask" not retrieved.

ledger.sentence: Avoiding food for several hours beforehand may be needed for this version.
ledger.note: NHS: may need to avoid eating for several hours before TOE.

ledger.sentence: Afterwards the throat may be sore, and this should pass within one or two days.
ledger.note: NHS: throat may be sore afterwards, passing within 1 to 2 days.

ledger.sentence: An NHS trust says a transoesophageal echocardiogram can look at the heart valves and heart muscle, and check for blood clots and tears in the aorta.
ledger.note: RBHT: can look at valves and heart muscle, clots, aortic tears. Heart muscle after a heart attack not retrieved; source is an NHS trust not nhs.uk page.

ledger.sentence: An NHS trust says it can help guide surgeons during some heart procedures.
ledger.note: RBHT: can guide surgeons during procedures such as mitral valve surgery; "plan surgery" not retrieved.

ledger.sentence: The British Heart Foundation says an echocardiogram uses sound waves to build up a picture of the heart and its structures, such as the valves.

ledger.sentence: It describes the test as an important investigation for anyone with suspected heart failure, heart valve problems or cardiomyopathy, a disease of the heart muscle.
ledger.note: BHF: important investigation for anyone with suspected heart failure, heart valve problems or cardiomyopathy.

ledger.sentence: Like other ultrasound scans, which the NHS says do not use radiation, an echocardiogram uses sound waves.

ledger.sentence: The NHS says some people may be able to talk to a doctor about the result on the day, but most people wait a few weeks.
